instruction: Fix `parse_csv` in `datastore/csvio.py` so it returns `(None, [])` for empty input instead of crashing. It currently tries to read `rows[0]` even when there are no rows, raising `IndexError`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore/csvio.py b/datastore/csvio.py
--- a/datastore/csvio.py
+++ b/datastore/csvio.py
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@
     """
     reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))
     rows = [row for row in reader]
-    if has_header:
+    if has_header and rows:
         return rows[0], rows[1:]
     return None, rows
